title: DIMENSION picture BLOCK full-conversion fast slice
mode: local generated test implementation and focused verification
scope: Exercise strict adapter export and import for a DIMENSION picture block
Verify the modelspace DIMENSION, named BLOCK_RECORD, BLOCK body, LINE child, and owner handle survive
Verify a missing picture body refuses output without replacing an existing destination

implementation.implementationNote: The test constructs DRW_DimAligned through its explicit const DRW_Dimension& constructor. Its implicit derived copy inherits the base copy's eType reset to DRW::DIMENSION, which would make the test entity unhandled by the aligned-dimension adapter path.

assertions: Strict export succeeds with a complete picture BLOCK_RECORD/BLOCK/body graph in ASCII and Binary DXF.
Import returns true and retains exactly one modelspace DIMENSION with the expected picture-block name.
Imported BLOCK_RECORD identity matches the named BLOCK body owner.
The picture body contains one LINE whose parentHandle is the BLOCK_RECORD handle.
Strict export refuses a DIMENSION referencing an absent picture body and preserves the destination sentinel.
limitations: This is generated local writer/readback evidence, not an independent reader result.
It proves record/name/body/child-owner structure only, not anonymous-constraint classification, nested resources, picture geometry, or rendering.
No external or committed drawing fixture, new dependency, full suite, peer, or native application was used.
